description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_LuxuryAirplane"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Specifications" name="Airplane specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Requirements" name="Manufacturing requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Components" name="Manufactured parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Airplane" name="Airplane delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Producer" name="Produce luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Producer_Start" name="Production begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Producer_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Produce_Base" name="Produce the standard base airplane">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Producer_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Producer_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_Specifications" name="Receive customer specifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Producer_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Producer_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Requirements" name="Send requirements to the manufacturing teams" messageRef="Message_Requirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Producer_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Producer_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_Components" name="Receive manufactured parts" messageRef="Message_Components">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Producer_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Producer_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Assemble_Interior" name="Assemble the airplane interior">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Producer_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Producer_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="Test_Flight" name="Conduct test flight and create test protocol">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Producer_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Producer_7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="TestFlight_Start" name="Test flight begins">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="TestFlight_Split" name="Conduct flight and prepare protocol">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_1</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_2</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:parallelGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Perform_Flight" name="Perform test flight">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_2</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Create_Protocol" name="Create test protocol for the producer and customer">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_3</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Protocol" name="Send test protocol to the customer" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_5</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_6</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="TestFlight_Join" name="Complete flight and protocol work">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_4</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_6</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_7</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:parallelGateway>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="TestFlight_End" name="Flight and protocol work complete">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_7</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_1" sourceRef="TestFlight_Start" targetRef="TestFlight_Split"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_2" sourceRef="TestFlight_Split" targetRef="Perform_Flight"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_3" sourceRef="TestFlight_Split" targetRef="Create_Protocol"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_4" sourceRef="Perform_Flight" targetRef="TestFlight_Join"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_5" sourceRef="Create_Protocol" targetRef="Send_Protocol"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_6" sourceRef="Send_Protocol" targetRef="TestFlight_Join"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_7" sourceRef="TestFlight_Join" targetRef="TestFlight_End"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Deliver_Airplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer" messageRef="Message_Airplane">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Producer_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Producer_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_Confirmation" name="Receive customer delivery confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Producer_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Producer_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Producer_End" name="Delivery confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Producer_9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_TeamAssignments">
      <bpmn:text>Examples: the Russian team manufactures the vodka bar; the Irish team manufactures the whiskey bar.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_TeamAssignments" sourceRef="Send_Requirements" targetRef="Annotation_TeamAssignments"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_1" sourceRef="Producer_Start" targetRef="Produce_Base"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_2" sourceRef="Produce_Base" targetRef="Receive_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_3" sourceRef="Receive_Specifications" targetRef="Send_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_4" sourceRef="Send_Requirements" targetRef="Receive_Components"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_5" sourceRef="Receive_Components" targetRef="Assemble_Interior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_6" sourceRef="Assemble_Interior" targetRef="Test_Flight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_7" sourceRef="Test_Flight" targetRef="Deliver_Airplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_8" sourceRef="Deliver_Airplane" targetRef="Receive_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_9" sourceRef="Receive_Confirmation" targetRef="Producer_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Specify and receive luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Customer_Start" name="Customer process begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Specify_Interior" name="Choose one of five bars and specify seat count, color, and toilet water amount">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Specifications" name="Send airplane specifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_Protocol" name="Receive test protocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_Airplane" name="Receive delivered airplane" messageRef="Message_Airplane">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Confirm_Delivery" name="Confirm delivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Confirmation" name="Send delivery confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Customer_End" name="Delivery confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_7</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Customer_Start" targetRef="Specify_Interior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Specify_Interior" targetRef="Send_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Send_Specifications" targetRef="Receive_Protocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Receive_Protocol" targetRef="Receive_Airplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Receive_Airplane" targetRef="Confirm_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Confirm_Delivery" targetRef="Send_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Send_Confirmation" targetRef="Customer_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Airplane producer" processRef="Process_Producer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Manufacturers" name="Manufacturing teams"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Specifications" name="Specifications" sourceRef="Send_Specifications" targetRef="Receive_Specifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Requirements" name="Manufacturing requirements" sourceRef="Send_Requirements" targetRef="Participant_Manufacturers" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Components" name="Manufactured parts" sourceRef="Participant_Manufacturers" targetRef="Receive_Components" messageRef="Message_Components"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Protocol" name="Test protocol" sourceRef="Send_Protocol" targetRef="Receive_Protocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Airplane" name="Airplane delivery" sourceRef="Deliver_Airplane" targetRef="Receive_Airplane" messageRef="Message_Airplane"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Delivery confirmation" sourceRef="Send_Confirmation" targetRef="Receive_Confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
